name: track geometry
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 描述轨道形状及空间位置的几何状态。

complete_examples.text: The changes of track geometry in P-PRBT and CRTS III under different forms of fault were analysed, the mechanical behaviour of track compo nents was revealed.
The variation of track geometry is divided into vertical irregularity (vertical profile and cross level irregularity) and transverse irregularity (gauge and alignment irregularity).
